title: COSE_Sign1 tagged/untagged accept-both not implemented uniformly (decision cose-sign1-tag18; R-06-324 et al.)
description: Decision spec/decisions.jsonl cose-sign1-tag18 (2026-09-03): 'Accept both tag-18 (tagged) and untagged COSE_Sign1 forms in all decoders.' Current per-decoder status: capability announcements — Python accepts both (crypto/capability_announcements.py:244-248), Rust accepts both (lichen-gateway/src/capability_announcements.rs:96-100), C REJECTS tag-18 (gateway/capability_announce.h:126-129 'A CBOR tag 18 wrapper is malformed'). Root DIO signature — Rust REQUIRES tag-18, rejects untagged (lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/root_sig.rs:205-209); Python accepts untagged only, rejects CBORTag (crypto/root_dio_signature.py:251); C handles tag-18 (root_dio_sig.c:34-35,124). Cross-stack mismatch in both directions per envelope; no cross-stack test pins both forms. Fix: make every COSE_Sign1 decoder (root-DIO sig, capability announce, tunnel-auth, key-rotation, credentials, slot-claim) accept both tag-18 and untagged per RFC 9052, add two-form vectors/tests. Suggested placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/gateway/capability_announce.c, rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/root_sig.rs, python/src/lichen/crypto/root_dio_signature.py + shared vector.
